newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, loses early edge.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, loses early edge.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka ended stronger on Tuesday at 43.7500/7600 to the dollar but retreated from earlier gains following a midday rise in the dollar, dealers said. The previous close was at 43.7600/7700.
Some fresh dollar inflows and a continuing rise in call rates helped the local unit open at 43.7450/7550, but it lost ground later on importer demand for dollars.
Interbank call money rates closed unchanged at 12 to 14 percent in an illiquid market.
